hardware: RTX 4070, CUDA toolkit 11.8, SM89, upstream GPU MLS-MPM
official_smoke: Official example_cutting physics loop with headless display callback, 310 frames, 10000 finite particles.

setup.trial_units: positions m, seconds; CRESSim internally cm, g, s
setup.blade: native quad slicer 160 x 61.4 mm, fatten 2 mm on each side, friction 0
setup.half_open: Material patches 12-35 mm to either side above z=78.56 mm, prescribed axial movement 4 mm each over 31.25 ms; half_free/sham_free hold the same patches at zero displacement.
setup.full_move: Right component receives +0.6 m/s once after withdrawal. Free runs receive zero kick. CRESSim contact and MPM damping used, no extra velocity decay.
setup.side_tracker: When the straight finite cutting edge reaches particle height, record its side. Exclude opposite-side reference edges within the 2.5 mm rest graph. Geometric graph check, separate from the physical opening test.

half.pair_spacing_definition: Median signed axial center spacing of original neighbors straddling the cut, grouped by original height above 74.56 mm or below 58.56 mm. This includes rest particle spacing (~2 mm).

full.independent_passive_note: Both loaded and unloaded composite replays use the same independent passive grid trajectory. Its zero additional response is imposed by construction. There is no inter-piece collision coupling after this hand-off.
full.handoff: At full depth in primary 7.629 us run. Each retained group keeps all stress/deformation history by a matched complete replay followed by masking the complementary particles.
full.directly_loaded_motion_reference: Additional axial center-of-mass displacement over the post-withdrawal interval, subtracting the same interval in the no-kick control. Restrict each comparison to IDs assigned to the same side in both GPU replays.

geometry.during_motion: Linear tests across recorded kinematic updates (16 or 32 etc. substeps depending on dt). Cross the mid-plane within the finite blade footprint, excluding its 1 mm rim. Not an exhaustive physics-substep CCD test.

notes: Single reference specimen. Native slicer, flat blade and contact envelope replace the previous wedge.

Sensitivity includes a coarse immediate-handoff run which reached the grid-boundary guard after withdrawal; excluded from quantitative comparison. Independent-grid primary branch ran at the finer step.

A separate repeat of the 7.629 us native full-cut run reached the grid boundary. Reported numeric results are from completed bounded runs. The native USD uses five full-particle keyframes from the measured run.
USD and video are replays of CRESSim coordinates. USD nodes are selectable, the replay has no live PhysX interaction.
